🎥 Licensed & Insured · Logan & Surrounds

CCTV Security Camera Installation Logan. Protect Your Home Or Business.

Secure My Property

Professional Installation

Don't Just Have A Camera That Records, Deter Them.

Many basic security cameras only record, they don't deter. We fit features that actively warn people off: spotlights, audio warnings, and flashing red-and-blue lights when motion is detected. These features usually aren't available in do-it-yourself kits, which often run flat on batteries exactly when you need them most. A hard-wired system costs a little more upfront, but it means never looking back.

Logan's mix of high-density apartments, holiday rentals and beachside properties makes visible, reliable security more important than ever, and a growing number of local homes and businesses are choosing wired systems over battery-powered DIY kits for exactly that reason.

What's Included

Home & Business Surveillance, Done Right.

All of our home security options are hard-wired cameras, which offer better protection than cheaper alternatives. Every quote includes all cabling, mounting, and a DVR box recording up to 2 weeks of footage (more if required). On the day, we determine the best camera placements from over 20 years of experience, and can connect cameras to your TV with a 1.5 to 3m HDMI cable and set up mobile access, with ongoing phone and remote technical support after installation.

Comprehensive CCTV Solutions

Whatever The Job, We've Got You Covered.

From a minimum of $400 for installation-only BYO packages, to our full supply-and-install packages below, we can even upgrade your existing system.

🛠️

Expert Installation

Minimal disruption to your day, from a basic home setup to complex commercial installs, we'll teach you how to use it afterwards too.

🎥

Reliable Coverage

Crystal-clear day footage and strong night vision, in packages from as few as 1 camera to as many as 10.

📍

Local Logan Service

Over 20 years' experience installing security systems for Logan homes and businesses.

🤝

After-Installation Support

Our relationship doesn't end at install, ongoing support and maintenance so your system keeps working, unlike cheap eBay purchases.

Bring Your Own Camera

Already Bought A System But Need Help Installing It?

Our team has experience with all brands including Swann CCTV, Arlo, Nest, Samsung, Uniden and Concord. A professional installer ensures correct placement, a clean finish and concealed cabling, user interfaces vary by manufacturer, so mounting and cabling is what's covered for BYO jobs.

Wired vs. Wireless

Reasons To Stay Away From DIY Wireless Cameras.

Brands like Arlo, Ring, Google Nest, Blink and TP-Link Tapo all offer tempting DIY kits, here's why a professional hard-wired install still wins.

📶

Reliability

A stable, continuous connection, no signal drops or interference that can affect wireless systems.

🔒

Security

Wired systems are far less vulnerable to hacking than wireless cameras transmitting data over the air.

🎞️

Video Quality

Higher resolution, clearer feeds, not limited by bandwidth or WiFi signal strength.

🔋

No Batteries Required

Powered directly, no recharging, and no risk of a flat camera exactly when an incident happens.

💵

Long-Term Value

More durable and lower maintenance over time, no ongoing subscription fees for notifications or mobile access.

📈

Scalability

Easy to expand with more cameras, without straining your home WiFi network.

Why It's Worth It

Benefits Of Video Surveillance & Alarm Systems.

  • Deter Crime. Visible cameras can prevent burglaries and other criminal activity.
  • Continuous Monitoring, 24/7 surveillance of your property.
  • Legal Evidence. Footage can be used as evidence in legal cases.
  • Peace of Mind. Knowing your property is monitored.
  • Insurance Discounts. Many insurers offer lower premiums with security systems installed.
  • Remote Access. Live feed viewing and alerts on your mobile.
  • System Integration. Cameras integrate with alarms and access controls.
  • Cost-Effective. Long-term security benefits outweigh the initial investment.
  • Business Management. Monitor productivity and customer behaviour.
  • Safety Enhancement. Prevent accidents and respond quickly to emergencies.

Frequently Asked Questions

CCTV Camera Questions, Answered.

What's the difference between a licensed master security installer and someone who isn't?

We're not only licensed and qualified to install security cameras, but a master cabler as well, meaning your cabling is neat, tidy and follows industry standards, to the level of a fully experienced data cable installer. Common beginner mistakes we've seen at other jobs include:

  • Poor camera placement
  • Neglecting sufficient lighting
  • Failure to secure cameras properly
  • Messy cabling done by someone unqualified
  • Failing to consider privacy concerns
What are the different types of CCTV cameras?

With so many options, here's a brief overview of what we work with:

  • IP / Network Camera. Almost all cameras now, letting you check footage and live feed from anywhere in the world.
  • Turret Camera. Small, rounded, dome-shaped cameras pointing to one side with a wide capture angle. Common in homes and businesses.
  • Bullet Camera. The long-headed camera style seen in shops and malls, great for zooming into specific areas like number plates.
  • Dome Camera. Dome-shaped, mostly indoor/commercial, hides which way the lens is pointing.
Can your CCTV record sound?

Yes, all of our systems can record sound, and some have 2-way audio so you can speak to whoever triggers the alarm, for example giving a delivery driver permission to leave a package somewhere specific.

Can CCTV footage be used as evidence?

Yes. CCTV footage is a crucial tool in legal and law enforcement scenarios, used for prevention, detection, investigation, prosecution or punishment of offences, and in court or tribunal proceedings. It must be handled correctly, clear, unaltered, and timestamped, to serve as reliable evidence.

Will installing CCTV bring down my insurance premium?

Many insurers do offer lower premiums for properties with a monitored security system installed, it's worth asking your insurer directly, as policies vary. We can provide documentation of your installed system if your insurer requires it.
